summary.text: Scott Conklin is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 77, which he has represented since December 2006, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Before entering the legislature he ran a carpentry business and currently owns an antique mall.

paragraphs.text: Conklin studied carpentry at Clearfield County Vocational Technical School from 1975 to 1977 and worked as a carpenter's apprentice from 1977 to 1980.
He received a Universal Certificate as a refrigerant technician in 1995, owned and operated a carpentry business from 1989 to 2007, and is the owner and operator of Conklin's Corner Antique Mall.
In the 2021-2022 session Conklin was Democratic chair of the House State Government Committee and of the Gaming Oversight Committee, and in 2023-2024 he chaired the House State Government Committee.
